Subject: Re: Local SI capacity & comms runbook — APAC/EU onboarding

Hi Kimberly / Laura / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call last week. As we begin contract negotiations on the Nephos pilot (UK + APAC territories) procurement has asked for a short runbook that outlines:

- the local SI onboarding flow (milestones and owners)
- expected capacity and surge windows per territory (we can provide rough forecasts)
- data residency and evidence checklist they should expect to receive
- primary communication channel and escalation contacts for first 90 days

Can you share a draft runbook and any SLA matrix you typically send to SIs for territory onboarding? Procurement also asked for a short set of attachments they can use for their internal risk review (SOC2 extracts, network topology diagram). I attached our initial request doc for context.

We'd like to get a draft by EOD Thursday (UK time) if possible — procurement has a gate on 09/17.

Thanks,
Ravi Kapoor
Head of Cloud Integrations
Unify Consulting
Attachment: initial-request.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Kapoor <ravi.kapoor@unify-consulting.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Local SI capacity & comms runbook — APAC/EU onboarding

Ravi — appreciate the clear ask and the timeline. Attached is a working draft of the runbook plus our standard SLA matrix. High level:

1) Onboarding stages (owner): intake (sales/partnerships), technical assessment (solutions eng), pilot deployment (dedicated eng + SI), go-live handoff (CS + SI).
2) Territory capacity: we include per-region baseline/peak throughput. For pilot please confirm expected monthly token volumes and concurrency targets so we can map to Dedicated vs Hosted fallbacks.
3) Data residency evidence: SOC 2 summary, encryption/KMS notes, network egress diagram — we have these redacted for initial review (see evidence-scan zip).
4) Comms: Slack channel for day-to-day, Pager duty for SE on-call during pilot, and a single escalation email alias that includes the on-call leads.

Next steps: can you confirm the expected concurrency targets for UK and APAC, and whether Nephos requires an on-prem evaluation instance? If procurement needs DocuSign for the retainer, loop procurement@nephos-isv.co.uk and we'll prep the SOW.

I attached: local-si-runbook-draft.docx, sla-matrix.xlsx, evidence-scan-20270909.zip

— Kimberly Park
Director, Partnerships Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Petrov <elena.petrov@nephos-isv.co.uk>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ravi Kapoor <ravi.kapoor@unify-consulting.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Local SI capacity & comms runbook — APAC/EU onboarding

Thanks Kimberly — the materials look good overall. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Data residency: for EU we require confirmation that the Nephos tenant will have data-at-rest in the EU region for production (we can accept redwood-hosted EU Dedicated). Please add a clear statement in the runbook about which model variants are allowed to serve EU production data.
- Evidence: procurement would like an explicit list of files we will receive post-contract (SOC2 full report vs summary, key management certificate, network diagram). The evidence-scan zip is helpful; can you make a short index in the runbook?
- Escalations: Nephos security wants a named technical contact (not alias) and an SLA for initial response during the pilot (we usually expect 4 business hour P1 acknowledge).

On the capacity question: UK pilot will be modest — ~200k tokens/day, concurrency peak 8. APAC pilot (Singapore) may spike to 1.2M tokens/day with concurrency up to 40. We are evaluating whether to run APAC on a Nephos-managed on-prem gateway — will confirm early next week.

We can accept a redacted SOC2 plus the KMS note for initial procurement review; if we progress to contract signature we will need the full report under NDA.

Best,
Elena
Head of Platform Partnerships
Nephos ISV
